title: Observability quickstart: Dashboard assets & screenshot pack for latency, cost-per-token, and trace views
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a cohesive screenshot and asset pack for the Observability section of the onboarding/quickstart docs. Focus areas: end-to-end latency dashboards (95th/99th pct and heatmaps), cost-per-token breakdowns by route/model, and distributed trace views for request lifecycle. Assets must work in the quickstart flow (three-panel hero, deep-dive modal, and downloadable one-pager), include light/dark variants, and be structured for in-doc cropping and alt-text implementation.
acceptance_criteria: One hero screenshot (wide) showing dashboard summary: 95th & 99th latency, cost-per-token sparkline, and top error traces
Three deep-dive screenshots: latency histogram & heatmap, cost-per-token waterfall with route filter applied, and distributed trace timeline for a slow request
All images exported in 3 sizes (hero 1400px, doc inline 840px, thumbnail 420px) and both light/dark colorways
Figma file updated with named frames and export presets, and annotated alt-text suggestions for each image
Design review sign-off from PM (Ava Patel) and Engineering reviewer (Liam O'Connor) documented in comments
Assets uploaded to Drive and referenced in the quickstart docs PR with exact paths
tasks: Draft initial wireframes for hero and deep-dive views in Figma
Coordinate with Observability eng to get realistic sample data sets (latency distributions, cost breakdowns)
Build visual comps (light/dark) and internal copy for panels and tooltips
Export screenshots in required sizes and name them to the asset naming convention
Add alt-text drafts and upload assets to Drive under /Redwood/Onboarding/Observability/2026-03
Create PR in docs repo referencing assets and update quickstart markdown with new screenshots
